# Branch Protection Record

Apply separately after the public repository exists:

- Protect main and active release branches.
- Require pull requests, selected status checks, conversation resolution, and squash merge.
- Block force pushes and deletion.
- Disable direct pushes except documented emergency recovery.
- Protect stable tags from deletion or movement when repository-level rules permit.
- Cut release/1.0 only when v1.0.0-rc.1 begins.
